cases.expected: Starter requests 100m/64Mi equal its limits; the edited source keeps limits 100m/64Mi with requests 10m/16Mi. Requests influence placement and quota; limits constrain runtime use.

cases.task: Sum requests for two replicas and convert 64Mi to bytes.

cases.expected: Broker refuses requests greater than limits before creating resources.

cases.task: Match Forbidden/exceeded quota and Pending/FailedScheduling to their stages.
cases.expected: Admission budget versus scheduler placement, with separate minimal investigations.

cases.task: Review a scoped synthetic OOMKilled record and a generic exit 137 record.
cases.expected: OOMKilled is specific memory-enforcement evidence; exit 137 alone is insufficient to prove that cause.

cases.task: Write a repair for one of the three failure records and its acceptance condition.
cases.expected: One justified source/resource change, phase-specific success evidence and owned cleanup.
